claim.quote: We report the observation of a narrow charmonium-like state produced in the exclusive decay process B+ -> K+ pi+pi- J/psi.

date.note: arXiv submission date (v1, 8 September 2003). Published as Phys. Rev. Lett. 91, 262001 (2003).

key_value.quote: has a mass of 3872.0+-0.6(stat)+-0.5(syst) MeV, a value that is very near the M_D + M_D* mass threshold

name: Observation of the X(3872)

significance.quote: The statistical significance of the signal is in excess of 10 sigma.

summary.plain: Belle reported the observation of a narrow new state, called the X(3872) in the paper, seen in B-meson decays to π⁺π⁻J/ψ. Its mass is very near the D⁰D̄*⁰ threshold; the paper says this mass, and the absence of a strong signal in a related decay channel, are in some disagreement with expectations for one specific charmonium state, and calls the mass suggestive of a loosely bound molecular state, as proposed by some authors.
summary.technical: Observation of a narrow state decaying to π⁺π⁻ J/ψ in B⁺ → K⁺ π⁺π⁻ J/ψ, mass 3872.0 ± 0.6(stat) ± 0.5(syst) MeV, very close to the D⁰D̅*⁰ threshold, with a statistical significance in excess of 10σ in 152M BB̅ events.

title: Observation of a narrow charmonium-like state in exclusive B± → K± π⁺π⁻ J/ψ decays
why_it_matters: The paper says the mass and the absence of a strong signal in the γχc1 channel 'are in some disagreement with potential model expectations for the 3Dc2 charmonium state', and that the mass is within errors of the D⁰D̄*⁰ threshold, which is 'suggestive of a loosely bound D D̄* multiquark molecular state, as proposed by some authors'.
